localeCompare reads a lone surrogate as U+FFFD

steps.why: A lone surrogate collates as U+FFFD, as Go's and Rust's collators read it and as .NET's CompareInfo does once the text is well formed. node's ICU gives an unpaired surrogate its own weight instead ('\ud800'.localeCompare('\ufffd') is -1 there).

name: the engine adds no host globals

steps.why: Jint, as C# builds it, has none of these names. goja has none either; QuickJS's full context adds atob, btoa, DOMException, performance and queueMicrotask, which Rust leaves out. A bundle that feature-detects one must see the same answer on every server.

name: JSON.parse stops past 64 levels

expect.result: SyntaxError: Max. depth level of JSON reached at position 64 | SyntaxError: Max. depth level of JSON reached at position 320 | SyntaxError: Max. depth level of JSON reached at position 71

steps.why: Jint's JSON.parse refuses a 65th nested array or object (Options.Json.MaxParseDepth, default 64, which C# keeps). Go and Rust wrap JSON.parse to match, message and position (UTF-16 index of the bracket) included. A bracket inside a string does not count.

expect.result: SyntaxError: Max. depth level of JSON reached at position 320

steps.why: A value the bundle built itself is refused too: the cap is in JSON.parse, not on the input.

expect.result: SyntaxError: Max. depth level of JSON reached at position 69 | SyntaxError: Max. depth level of JSON reached at position 70

steps.why: Positions count UTF-16 units: a lone surrogate is one, a pair two.
